model_interpretation.claim: For positive target masses, accumulating acceleration directly cancels the per-pair target-mass factor and the final division by target mass. Computing softened reciprocal-distance-cubed with rsqrtf and two multiplies may also reduce per-pair arithmetic. Correctness, especially for extreme masses, must be established by the oracle before any timing comparison.
